intro: Valencia rewards visitors with old-town charm, bold modern architecture and easy beach days. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: Metro València has 9 lines (some trams); single zone fare about €1.50 plus €1 for the card.
EMT buses reach most districts; single ticket about €2, pay the driver by cash or card.
SUMA 10 card gives 10 journeys on metro and bus, about €8 plus card fee.
Taxis are metered; airport trips add a supplement. Ride apps like Uber, Bolt and Cabify operate.
The centre is flat and walkable; bikes and the Turia park paths are popular.
No ferry service for visitors; regional trains leave from Estació del Nord.

city-arts-sciences.name: City of Arts and Sciences
city-arts-sciences.price_text: Free to walk the complex · individual venues charge entry
city-arts-sciences.hours: Outdoor areas always open · venues roughly 10:00–19:00, check on the day
city-arts-sciences.tip: Walk the whole complex at dusk when the white shells light up and the pools reflect them.

valencia-cathedral.name: Valencia Cathedral
valencia-cathedral.price_text: ≈ EUR 8–10 for the cathedral and museum, check on the day
valencia-cathedral.hours: Roughly 10:00–18:30, shorter on Sundays; check on the day
valencia-cathedral.tip: Climb the tower for the best old-town view, and go early to avoid the queue.

central-market.name: Central Market of Valencia
central-market.price_text: Free to enter · food priced per item
central-market.tip: Come before 11:00 for the full stalls and a fresh pastry at the counter bars.

turia-gardens.name: Turia Gardens (Jardín del Turia)
turia-gardens.tip: Rent a bike and ride the full length from the Bioparc end to the City of Arts and Sciences.

la-lonja.name: La Lonja de la Seda
la-lonja.price_text: ≈ EUR 2 · free on Sundays and public holidays, check on the day
la-lonja.hours: Roughly 09:30–19:00, closed Monday; check on the day
la-lonja.tip: Look up in the main hall — the twisted stone columns are the reason to come.

torres-serranos.name: Torres de Serranos
torres-serranos.price_text: ≈ EUR 2 · free on Sundays, check on the day
torres-serranos.tip: Climb to the top for a free-feeling view over the old town and the Turia riverbed.

bioparc.name: Bioparc Valencia
bioparc.price_text: ≈ EUR 25–30 adult, cheaper online and for children
bioparc.hours: Daily roughly 10:00–18:00 or 20:00 in summer; check on the day
bioparc.tip: Book online for a lower price and go early — the animals are most active before the heat.

dunas.name: DUNAS
dunas.price_text: Check on the day — beach bar prices vary
dunas.hours: Seasonal, roughly daytime into late evening in summer
dunas.tip: A beach bar on the sand near the port; confirm opening and prices before you go.

oceanografic.name: L'Oceanografic
oceanografic.price_text: ≈ EUR 30–38 adult, cheaper online and for children
oceanografic.hours: Daily roughly 10:00–18:00 or 20:00 in summer; check on the day
oceanografic.tip: Buy tickets online and go on a weekday morning; the tunnel and Arctic zone get busy.

mestalla.name: Mestalla
mestalla.price_text: ≈ EUR 12–18 stadium tour, match tickets extra; check on the day
mestalla.hours: Tour times vary by day and match schedule; check on the day
mestalla.tip: Check the fixture list first — a match night is the real experience, but tours stop.

mountasia.name: Mountasia Family Fun Center
mountasia.price_text: Check on the day — pay per activity
mountasia.tip: A family activity centre; confirm location, hours and prices before making the trip.

paella.name: Paella
paella.price_text: ≈ EUR 15–25 per person at a mid-range restaurant
paella.tip: Eat it at lunch, not dinner, and order the Valencian version with rabbit and chicken.

russafa-market.name: Ruzafa food market and tapas bars
russafa-market.price_text: Free to wander · tapas roughly EUR 3–8 per plate
russafa-market.hours: Market mornings · bars from evening, closed some Mondays
russafa-market.tip: Come hungry in the evening and hop between small bars rather than one big dinner.

carmen-walk.name: El Carmen old-town walk
carmen-walk.tip: Get a little lost in the narrow lanes and look for street art on the walls.

albufera-boat.name: Albufera lagoon boat trip
albufera-boat.price_text: ≈ EUR 5–15 short boat ride; check on the day
albufera-boat.hours: Daytime, seasonal; check on the day
albufera-boat.tip: Pair the boat with a sunset at the dunes and a rice lunch nearby.

malvarrosa-beach.name: Malvarrosa beach promenade
malvarrosa-beach.tip: Walk the promenade and stop for a drink at one of the beach bars.

colon-market.name: Colón Market
colon-market.price_text: Free to enter · food priced per item
colon-market.hours: Roughly 07:00–15:00 weekdays, shorter Saturday; check on the day
colon-market.tip: A quieter, more local market than the Central Market — good for a quick lunch.

serranos-viewpoint.name: Puente de Serranos viewpoint
serranos-viewpoint.tip: Stand on the bridge at dusk for the classic photo of the towers and the old gate.

horchateria.name: Horchata and fartons tasting
horchateria.price_text: ≈ EUR 3–6 for a glass and a pastry
horchateria.hours: Daytime, roughly 09:00–20:00; some close in winter
horchateria.tip: Try horchata with fartons — it is the local afternoon treat, best in summer.

plaza-virgen.name: Plaza de la Virgen
plaza-virgen.tip: Sit on the steps at night when the cathedral and fountain are lit up.

stays.why: Walk to the cathedral, Central Market and Plaza de la Virgen. Busiest and noisiest at night.
Old quarter with street art and small bars. Lively and central, but can be loud late.
Best food and café scene; flat 15–20 minute walk to the old town.
Quieter, wide streets, good value; walkable to the centre and near the Turia park.

food: Try paella at lunch, not dinner. Valencians eat it midday; book a table at a proper restaurant.
Central Market (Mercat Central) is the place for jamón, olives and fresh produce. Go in the morning; check opening hours on the day.
Tapas and raciones in Ruzafa and El Carmen. Expect small plates to share, roughly €3–8 each.
Horchata with fartons is the local sweet drink. Try it at a horchatería in the afternoon.
The city water is fine to drink. Many bars charge for bread or a terrace seat; ask first.
more_time: Swap a beach afternoon for the Albufera lagoon south of the city: rice fields, boat trips and paella country. Check transport and tour options on the day.
Take a regional train from Estació del Nord to a nearby town for a half day. Buy tickets at the station.
Add a day for the City of Arts and Sciences: the science museum and oceanarium need several hours each.
